briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google accelerate multi-agent systems as race intensifies ahead of Q4 deployments

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 new models this month amid $11.9B quarterly funding. Multi-agent coordination and safety tooling are the dominant themes as regulatory pressure builds.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4-preview with advanced agent orchestration; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3.0 Pro both launched this week. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B while xAI and DeepSeek continue rapid iteration cycles.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra ramp with TSMC securing 2027 capacity; Microsoft and Google each broke ground on new 100k-GPU clusters in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first self-improving agent cluster emerge before 2027 or will safety bottlenecks delay autonomous recursion?
